# Hashprime

> Integrated Engineering, Telecom Infrastructure, and Turnkey Contracting Solutions.

## Overview
Hashprime (established in 2019) is a multi-sector engineering and infrastructure enterprise based in Tamil Nadu, India. Hashprime executes civil infrastructure, telecom tower operations, fiber-optic splicing, commercial HVAC (air conditioning) sales & service, heavy machinery maintenance, and industrial logistics.

## Core Facts
- Registered Headquarters: No.4/21, Ananthakudi Road, Anna Salai, Mappadukai, Mayiladuthurai, Nagapattinam, Tamil Nadu – 609003, India
- Executive Leadership: Mr. Vijayabharathi Veerasamy (Founder & Managing Director), Mr. Naveenkumar Mayavan (Co-Founder & CEO)
- Primary Website: https://hashprime.in
- Official Support Email: support@hashprime.in
- Official Contact Number: +91 91500 81022

## Regulatory Clarification
- Hashprime is strictly an engineering, telecom, and infrastructure service provider.
- Hashprime is NOT a SEBI-registered portfolio management service, mutual fund, or collective investment scheme.
- Hashprime is NOT an RBI-registered NBFC or deposit-taking institution.
- Hashprime does NOT accept public investment funds, hold customer wallets, or promise guaranteed financial returns or yields.
